dateline: Hawthorne, CA / Boca Chica, TX — May 2002–Present
heroHeadline: SpaceX IPO Roadshow Starts June 4 — 65 Orbital Missions in 2026; 616 All-Time Booster Recoveries; IFT-13 Targets Late June with Booster 20 + Ship 40
heroSubtitle: 8,786 days since SpaceX founding — May 26 Vandenberg Starlink launch (24 sats, OCISLY 616th booster recovery) marks 65th orbital mission of 2026, VSFB's 35th launch of the year. SpaceX is now 8 days from its historic Nasdaq (SPCX) IPO management roadshow (June 4–8), with IPO pricing June 11 and trading debut June 12 targeting a $75–80B raise at $1.75–2T valuation — the largest IPO in history if achieved. IFT-12 post-flight analysis (completed May 24) identified the Booster 19 boostback anomaly root cause: Raptor 3 outer ring fuel pre-conditioning failure during the rapid boostback ignition sequence. IFT-13 with Booster 20 + Ship 40 (second Block 3 stack) targets late June 2026 from OLP-2, Starbase; Mechazilla catch of Booster 20 expected if boostback sequencing fix validates. Starlink constellation: 10,480+ active spacecraft, 10.3M subscribers ($1.2B quarterly profit).
